name: AT&T Home Phone
why: Largest legacy Bell landline provider (22 states); national brand with its own myAT&T billing.

name: Verizon Home Phone (copper and Fios Digital Voice)
why: Major Northeast/Mid-Atlantic landline provider; national brand with My Verizon billing.

name: CenturyLink (Lumen) Home Phone
why: One of the largest ILEC landline footprints (former Qwest/Embarq territory).

name: Frontier Communications
why: Large national ILEC landline provider (25 states) with its own billing site.

name: Kinetic by Windstream
why: Large rural/suburban ILEC (18 states); distinct Go Kinetic billing site.

name: Brightspeed
why: Former CenturyLink ILEC territory (20 states) now a separate landline provider with its own billing.

name: Consolidated Communications (Fidium)
why: Multi-state ILEC (18 states, incl. legacy FairPoint in northern New England); replaces the Cox roster record (a CA Lifeline CLEC entity, not Cox's billing site).

name: TDS Telecom
why: Large rural ILEC group (27 states) with its own TDS ePay billing; replaces the Spectrum roster record (a FL Lifeline CLEC entity; Spectrum's real billing site is already covered by another category's dossier).

name: altafiber (Cincinnati Bell)
why: Legacy Bell ILEC for Greater Cincinnati with its own My altafiber billing; replaces Ooma, whose official public pages document almost no billing behaviour (card-on-file only, no bill).

name: Vonage Home Phone
why: Long-standing national VoIP home phone brand with its own account billing (card on file, paperless only).

name: Ziply Fiber
why: Former Frontier Northwest ILEC (WA, OR, ID, MT) with its own My Account billing; the largest incumbent landline provider not yet covered.

name: Hawaiian Telcom
why: Incumbent Bell landline carrier for all of Hawaii; owned by altafiber but billed through its own hawaiiantel.com My Account.

name: Alaska Communications
why: Largest incumbent landline carrier in Alaska with its own AccountView and QuickPay billing.

name: GCI
why: Alaska's largest cable/telecom provider; home phone billed in MyGCI.

name: magicJack
why: Long-standing national VoIP home phone brand; prepaid annual renewals with AutoRenew on a card (no monthly bill).

name: Comporium
why: Incumbent landline carrier for Rock Hill/York County SC and parts of NC with My Comporium billing.

name: Lumos (Lumos Fiber)
why: Legacy Lumos Telephone and North State ILEC (VA, NC); billing still in Lumos My Account during the T-Mobile Fiber integration.

name: Nuvera Communications
why: Publicly traded Minnesota ILEC (former New Ulm Telecom/Hutchinson) with its own Nuvera Online Account billing.

name: GTA (Guam)
why: Incumbent landline carrier for Guam with its own myGTA billing portal; replaces the Midco record (a CLEC roster entity whose real billing site is covered by the tv tier-2 Midco dossier).

name: Ritter Communications
why: Arkansas/Tennessee ILEC and fiber provider (incl. Millington Telephone) with its own online bill pay; replaces the Sparklight record (a CLEC roster entity whose real billing site is covered by the internet and tv tier-2 Sparklight dossiers).
